description: Visualize cell type populations and cell distance distributions of the healthy human heart.

content: This paper contributed single-cell data to HRApop, which estimates how cell types are distributed across healthy human anatomy. The resulting heart population estimates for healthy adult males and females were visualized in VR in the HRA Organ Gallery.
